page.layout: One column of dictionary entries on the page, with Hebrew, Latin and Greek type mixed. No margin notes, no block below the text. Printed page number top left, running head top centre, gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: & ל. Præterit. נָשְׂעַן עַל־חַנִּיתוֹ Incumbebat hastæ suæ, 2.Sam.1.6. Cum ל construitur Numer.21.15. Infinit. לְהִשָּׁעַן Inniti, Jes.10.20. Futur. וְאַל־בִּינָתְךָ אַל־תִּשָּׁעַן Et intelligentiæ tuæ ne innititor, Prov.3.15.
מִשְׁעָן m. Scipio, Baculus, Bacillus, 2.Sam.22.19. Constr. וְכָל־מִשְׁעַן לָחֶם Et omnem scipionem panis, Jesa.3.1.
מִשְׁעֲנֹת f. Idem, 2.Reg.18.v.21. Aff. עַל־מִשְׁעַנְתּוֹ Super scipione suo, Exod.21.19. Plural. cum Aff. בְּמִשְׁעֲנֹתָם Scipionibus suis, Num.21.18.
main_text.head: שַׁעַר
main_text.p: Æstimavit: Præter. כְּמוֹ שַׁעַר בְּנַפְשׁוֹ Ut æstimat cum animo suo, Prov.23.7.

שַׁעַר m. Porta, Genes.22.17. Vide mox in fine hujus Radicis: Cum ה locali, שַׁעְרָה In portam, Jesa.28.6. & sic Deut.22.15. Dual. שַׁעֲרַיִם Saharajim, Proprium nomen oppidi, 1.Sam.17.52. Jos.15.36. Plural. שְׁעָרִים Portæ, Psal.24.9. Et semel juxta aliam significationem, Mensuræ; מְאָה שְׁעָרִים Centum mensuras, Gen.26.12. Constr. שַׁעֲרֵי Portæ, Psal.87.2. Aff. בְּאוּ שְׁעָרָיו Ingredimini portas ejus, Psal.100.4.
שַׁעַר m. Janitor, 2.Reg.7.10. Plural. שְׁעָרִים, Neh.12.25. Constr. לְשַׁעֲרֵי Janitoribus liminum, 2.Par.23.4.
שַׁעַר m. Horrendus, ex significatione sequentis Radicis: Plural. הַשְּׁעָרִים כִּתְאֻנִּים Sicut ficus horrendas, Jeremem.29.17.
שַׁעֲרוּרִיָּה f. Idem, Hosea 6.10. Ex Horroris significatione quidam שַׁעַר Portarum nomen traductum putant, quod

page.notes: Several Hebrew words are small and worn, notably the vocalisation in the entries and the cross-reference after "Vide in" (marked [?]). The Hebrew in the root heading and in the entries was read from the scan and may carry small vowel errors. The printed Latin word "Jeremem.29.17." appears as printed, with the reference joined to the name. No catchword is visible at the foot.
